description: Land Title Settlement Department - Inguruwatta, Doluwa D/S Division, Kandy District - Cad. Map No. 320017
categorisation: This gazette content deals exclusively with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act, No. 21 of 1998. It contains declarations of determination by the Commissioner of Title Settlement regarding specific land parcels (including parcel numbers, ownership details, extents, and encumbrances) in various villages. The content focuses on land ownership, title settlements, and property registration, which falls squarely under the Land Gazettes category (Type 4) for land and property-related matters.
